quiz.question_id: Jika Anda perlu timeout dan custom header `Authorization`, pola mana yang paling sesuai dengan lesson?
quiz.question_en: If you need a timeout and a custom `Authorization` header, which pattern best matches the lesson?
options_id: Buat `http.Client{Timeout: ...}`, lalu `http.NewRequest`, set header, dan panggil `client.Do(req)`
options_en: Create `http.Client{Timeout: ...}`, then `http.NewRequest`, set headers, and call `client.Do(req)`

quiz.question_id: Mengapa `defer resp.Body.Close()` selalu penting setelah request berhasil?
quiz.question_en: Why is `defer resp.Body.Close()` always important after a successful request?
options_id: Agar resource response tidak bocor dan koneksi bisa dikembalikan ke pool
Agar header request bisa diubah lagi
options_en: So response resources do not leak and the connection can be returned to the pool
So the status code changes to 200
So request headers can be modified again

quiz.question_id: Fungsi mana yang digunakan lesson untuk mengubah payload Go menjadi JSON sebelum POST?
quiz.question_en: Which function does the lesson use to turn a Go payload into JSON before a POST?

quiz.question_id: Mengapa `bytes.NewBuffer(data)` diberikan ke `http.Post` pada contoh JSON POST?
quiz.question_en: Why is `bytes.NewBuffer(data)` passed to `http.Post` in the JSON POST example?
options_id: Karena `http.Post` membutuhkan body yang dapat dibaca sebagai stream, bukan `[]byte` mentah
Karena buffer otomatis menambah header Authorization
options_en: Because `http.Post` needs a readable body stream, not raw `[]byte`
Because the buffer automatically adds the Authorization header

quiz.question_id: Mengapa lesson memperingatkan untuk tidak memakai `http.DefaultClient` di production?
quiz.question_en: Why does the lesson warn against using `http.DefaultClient` in production?
options_id: Karena ia tidak punya timeout default sehingga request bisa hang selamanya
Karena ia tidak bisa membaca body response
Karena ia memaksa semua request menjadi GET
options_en: Because it has no default timeout, so a request can hang forever
Because it does not support TLS
Because it cannot read the response body
Because it forces every request to become GET

quiz.question_id: Pada helper `getGitHubUser`, mengapa `resp.StatusCode` diperiksa sebelum decode JSON?
quiz.question_en: In the `getGitHubUser` helper, why is `resp.StatusCode` checked before decoding JSON?
options_id: Agar bisa gagal lebih awal saat server mengembalikan status non-200 yang tidak sesuai ekspektasi
Karena decoder JSON membutuhkan status 200 untuk bekerja
options_en: So the function can fail early if the server returns a non-200 status that is not expected
Because the JSON decoder requires status 200 to work

quiz.question_id: Field mana yang tepat untuk dibandingkan dengan konstanta seperti `http.StatusOK`?
quiz.question_en: Which field should be compared with constants like `http.StatusOK`?

quiz.question_id: Apa keuntungan memakai `fmt.Errorf("request: %w", err)` atau `fmt.Errorf("decode: %w", err)`?
quiz.question_en: What is the benefit of using `fmt.Errorf("request: %w", err)` or `fmt.Errorf("decode: %w", err)`?
options_id: Error asli tetap terbungkus sambil diberi konteks tambahan
options_en: The original error stays wrapped while gaining extra context
The error is automatically turned into JSON
The program automatically retries the request
The response headers are copied into the error

quiz.question_id: Cara yang sesuai dengan lesson untuk decode JSON response body ke struct adalah...
quiz.question_en: The lesson-consistent way to decode a JSON response body into a struct is...
options_id: `io.ReadAll(resp.Body)` lalu assign ke struct secara manual tanpa parse
options_en: `io.ReadAll(resp.Body)` and then manually assign to the struct without parsing
